column2: {p}, we'll take a little rest here. Go and see Enma-kun.
Have you talked to Enma-kun yet?
What a strange building...\n\nIt's way bigger inside than it looks from outside.
Not a bad place to hang. Maybe I'll make this my hideout for a while!
There's food and drinks and everything. Nice room, huh?
Hell Villa seems to exist in a subspace. This Great King Enma who built it must be very powerful.
Yum! Yum! All the grub I can eat!
Boss, you're eatin' too much... I ain't losin' either!
Ever since we got here, all Yamagishi-kun does is eat.
Hey, you made it!
Enma-kun! So you were the one who found {s}...?
My job's beating up yokai who make trouble in the human world. We're the Yokai Patrol, see? And while we were on patrol, we found {s}.
So {s} was attacked by yokai?
No, that's not it. Enma-kun's yokai antennae, you see...
...reacted to me.
Long time no see, {p}!
Akira-kun! Why would the yokai antennae pick up on you...?
I'll explain the details later.\n\nIf we ever fight side by side, you'll understand then.
So what happened to you guys?
Actually...
So the folks who were with {p} went through stuff like that too. What do you think, Chapeau-jii?
This black moon sounds like a Hell Gate, my boy. A Hell Gate appears as a black moon. However, the black moon in this story...\n\nseems different from the Hell Gate we use, I say.
The Hell Gate links the Hell World and the human world. But the black moon in {p}'s story...
...seems to link many worlds together, it does...
Link worlds together...?
You mean the black moon is linking different dimensions together?
Could be. I sure don't get it... ...But maybe the Great King Enma-sama would.
Great King Enma... You mean the one who's supposed to be in Hell?
Yep, Great King Enma of Hell! He's my uncle!
But if I bring humans to the Hell World, I bet the Great King-sama'll chew me out...

What if we made {p} and friends members of the Yokai Patrol, eh?

If they're members of the Yokai Patrol,

I daresay the Great King-sama won't be angry...?
Nice one, Chapeau-jii!\n\nAll right! Starting today, you guys are members of the Yokai Patrol!
Whoa!?
My yokai antennae are already going bzzt! Let's go hunt some yokai! Once you've picked your team, meet in front of Hell Villa!
Yokai hunting, huh... This has gotten serious.
It's scary, but it beats being apart!
Picked your patrol members yet? Looks like yokai energy's coming from a nearby town. I'll go on ahead, so catch up!
What's wrong with the townspeople? Attacking us out of nowhere...
Enma-kun! Could it be, could it be, jaja! Take a good look at this person's body!
...There's a mark kind of like a skull?
Just as I thought! They breathed the breath of the yokai Dokuro, jaja!
So that means they're all hotheaded 'cause of the yokai Dokuro...
Indeed. Breathe Dokuro's breath and anyone flies into a rage, jaja! In Hell they called him "the Uncrowned Emperor"!
The Uncrowned Emperor...!
Heh, that sounds like fun! Beat Dokuro and you're a real Yokai Patrol member! Then I can take {p} to the Hell World!
I'm sensing strong yokai energy from the school... All right, let's search inside the school!
It's yokai everywhere! My yokai antennae are working overtime!
Then where's Dokuro...?
Means my yokai antennae can't tell! We'll just have to search all over! Good luck, {p}!
Ah! Wait up, Enma-kun!! ...He's gone.
Whoa!? An eerie wind's blowing in!?
The Uncrowned Emperor, the great yokai Dokuro, is coooming! Enma-kun! This is going to be a tough fight, jaja!
Wahahahaha!\n\nFeel the terror of Dokuro, the great yokai of the century, down to the marrow of your bones!
All right! {p}, go!
Go...? I'm the one fighting?
A full-fledged Yokai Patrol member can beat a guy like this, right? Then the Great King-sama of Hell'll be sure to see you!
Grr, you dare mock me!
You did it, {p}!\n\nNow you're a real Yokai Patrol member too! Hold on tight to me! We're off to the Hell World!
All riiight, let's go!
Whoaaa!
It's the black moon!
Nah, it's a Hell Gate!
Indeed, my boy. Pass through here and it's the Hell World.
Great King-sama, Enma reporting!
Enma, what is the meaning of this! Who are these people? Are they not humans!?
Great King-sama, he's a new member of the Yokai Patrol! {p} beat the yokai Dokuro!
Ohoh, that's quite something!\n\nAnd what business brings you all to Hell?
Actually...
Hmmm. A most peculiar tale... But the black moon you speak of is not a Hell Gate...
Really!?
An earthquake always follows the black moon's appearance, does it not? When you found the black moon with Enma-kun, did an earthquake strike?
And besides, the world is never just one. It's simply that they so often fail to notice one another.
It's true, folks in the human world don't know about the Hell World...
Then the world I came from is a different world from this one?
Most likely...
Then Honey's world and...
Mondo Saotome and Ryoma Mido's world...
And this world!\n\nIt would be no wonder at all if every one of them were a different world!
Whaaat! No way!\n\nThen how can we get back to our own world!?
I do not know...\n\nThe truth is, other events beyond my understanding are happening as well!
Great King-sama, what on earth has happened, eh?
Behold!
A temple in Kyoto called the Dark Temple.\n\nIt seems oni have been appearing around it lately...
Oni!? There's a ton of oni on Onigashima.
Behold, this is what the oni that appear in Kyoto look like!
Yikes! Scary-looking guys!
They really are... exactly what you picture an oni to be...
Enma, go to Kyoto and investigate the oni that appear at the Dark Temple!\n\nThose oni are a different breed from the oni of our world!
Oni from another world... Great King Enma! I'm going too!
Whoa, whoa, you sure about this?
I'm a member of the Yokai Patrol too, aren't I?
Hyohyohyo! Looks like he got you there, my boy!
But how do we get to Kyoto?\n\nThe earthquake cut Kanto off from the rest of Japan.
Why not move Hell Villa to Kyoto, eh?
Chapeau-jii! You're on fire!
Hmm! I shall create a subspace in Kyoto! First I'll send you there, then move Hell Villa after you!
All riiight! Oni hunting in Kyoto!
Thank you, Great King-sama!
Go, to Kyoto!
